title: Two loaded rails
description: From a 12V supply ('V1 vin 0 DC 12', required exactly) derive two rails with resistor dividers: node 'r5' at 5.0V +/-5% driving a fixed load 'Rl5 r5 0 100', and node 'r33' at 3.3V +/-5% driving a fixed load 'Rl33 r33 0 100'. Both load lines must appear in the netlist exactly as written. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
